remarks: Prepare to be wowed by this charming, street level one bed, one bath condominium in the Greenbriar complex. Experience living in the heartbeat of mid-city Stamford at its finest. This light, airy, freshly painted condo boasts gleaming hardwood floors in living room, dining room and bedroom. This generous sized, open concept living and dining room is flooded with abundant, natural light from double skylights and large sliding door leading out to a private patio overlooking a lovely manicured courtyard in the complex interior. A perfect spot for sipping your morning cappuccino or dining al fresco. The kitchen is well appointed with stainless steel appliances and a cozy breakfast bar. The spacious wood floored bedroom is flanked by a wall of double closets with plenty of storage space. A separate utility room equipped with its own washer/dryer and open shelving completes the condo footprint. The unit includes one reserved parking spot (a covered carport) for ease and convenience directly in front of the unit. Conveniently located within walking distance to downtown Stamford, with shopping, award-winning restaurants, vibrant nightlife, Metro North Railroad, Scalzi Park, Ridgeway Shopping Center and much, much more. All this awaits the savvy buyer. Simply unpack and move right in!
